bool fmc_flash_nor_read(uint32_t addr, void *data, uint32_t len)

Task-safe nor flash read.

参数:

  • data -- [in] Data buffer to be read into

  • len -- [in] Read data length

返回值:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Failed.

返回:

Read result
